references.text: For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
Do not judge, so that you will not be judged. Do not condemn, so that you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

Be careful! If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him. And if he sins against you seven times a day, and seven times comes back to you saying, 'I repent,' then you shall forgive him.
If you forgive anyone their sins, they are forgiven; if you hold them fast, they are held fast.
But you have forgiven it, so have I. For what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, I did it for your sake in the presence of Christ.
For judgment is without mercy to one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
